svg.aria-label: Push onto a list, in memory. Add one element at the end of a list of 10,000 that merges by position. Nothing touches the disk. ops/s, log scale, higher is better. Not shown: TinyBase (no list that merges by position); PouchDB (no list that merges by position); RxDB (no list that merges by position); Fireproof (no list that merges by position); GUN (needs its storage adapter to answer in Node.js); OrbitDB (no list that merges by position).
